title: Run, Reg, Run!
lines: Reg had a red rag and a big pup.
The pup got the rag and ran!
"Get it, Reg!" said Mom. He ran and ran.
The pup ran up on the rug.
Reg ran, but he did not get the rag.
Reg sat on the rug. He did not run.
The pup ran up to him and rubs him.
Reg gets the rag and hugs the pup.

questions.listenFor: The red rag. The story says it. If your child is unsure, point to the word rag and read that line again.

questions.ask: What did Reg do that finally worked?
questions.listenFor: He sat down and stopped running. Listen for the sitting - running after the pup did not work, waiting did.

questions.ask: Why do you think the pup came back when Reg sat down? Tell me what you think.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine - the pup wanted to play, or running off is only fun if someone runs after you. You want a reason.
